recordCorrections.correction: The policy-made-public mutation demonstrates the context-reassembly compile-fail example only; the other two were checked by the lead outside the lane.

rootAssessment: Substantive assent to the exact reviewed D2a r2 (M3-D r5 item 9; D2a plan r1): the common control codec, CC v5 exactly. An iterative strict RFC 8259 reader over a flat arena (duplicates on the decoded key at every depth, the reference's number lexeme rule, unpaired-surrogate strings kept as UTF-16 units); the embedded product schema evaluated by a closed interpreter of exactly its keywords, its document root closed too; classify in the reference's precedence; the session's fixed policy private (the 65,536 bound and offer and the admitted tuple, made only by for_session, read through getters, never reachable from the observations); an encoder that writes only the host's eight types and judges what it writes as its receiver would, with no identity substitution; and ControlSession::send as the selection-bound sending boundary. The 480-case corpus byte for byte, the full matrix, the prefix and resource probes; 16 new tests with equal failure sets; 16 mutations caught. Record correction (Codex D2A-R2-NBO-1): SCOPE says the policy-made-public mutation makes all three compile-fail examples compile, but that mutation exposes only ControlContext.policy, so the lane shows one example compiling (context reassembly); the other two were checked by the lead with every ControlPolicy field public (all three then compile), outside the lane. No production policy is exposed. Three new paths and control_protocol.rs realizing its planned row (inventory successor to follow); no caller (D3a), no stream acquisition (D3a), no provider protocol (D2b).
